purpose: Teach: 魅了/足らず/斜面/淡路/崖/持ち上げ/高温/ひき

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、新しい料理、お客様、魅了するもの、作ろか、本気で。
lines.en: Aoi — what if we created something totally new? A dish that actually wows the customers.
lines.style: Energetic and warm, Kansai lilt coloring the words. Leans forward with genuine excitement. Casual suggestion that carries real conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。仕入れ量、足らずに、お客様、お待たせしてしまったこと、ありますね、先月。
lines.en: Yes. We did run short on stock last month — had to keep customers waiting longer than we should have.
lines.style: Thoughtful, turning inward for a moment. Self-aware without being self-pitying. The words come slowly, checking the memory. Quiet acknowledgment of something she wishes had gone differently.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 新店舗、斜面に建ってる物件、内装、こだわらなあかんわ。
lines.en: The new location — it's built right into a slope. We've got to be really careful about how we design the space inside.
lines.style: Animated, gesturing slightly with the hands. Picks up speed as the practical problem becomes clear. Animated but grounded — this is serious planning, not just daydreaming.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。淡路島の食材、玉ねぎ、新メニューに、活かしましょう。
lines.en: Yes. We should really showcase what Awaji Island is known for — the onions especially. Build them into the new menu.
lines.style: Warm and collaborative. A small smile underneath. Not just agreeing, but actively joining the vision. Words land with gentle certainty.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 瀬戸内の崖の上に、見晴らしのいい店、出してみたいんや、葵さん。
lines.en: That's the dream, isn't it? A place on the cliff overlooking the Seto Inland Sea. Views for days. I want to make that happen, Aoi.
lines.style: Softer now, more vulnerable. The earnestness breaks through the usual bravado. Says her name like he's inviting her into something real. Breath steadier, pace slower.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。重たい食材、スタッフ、持ち上げる時、フォーム、教えますね。
lines.en: Yes. When we're moving the heavier ingredients around, I'll make sure to show the team proper form — safety first.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact and capable. No fuss, just the practical next step. The voice of someone who thinks three moves ahead. Grounded, almost maternal in its care.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 高温の厨房、エアコン、強化しよか、夏、近いし、葵さん。
lines.en: And the kitchen gets brutal in summer. We should definitely upgrade the AC before the heat hits.
lines.style: Practical suggestion offered lightly. Not demanding, but clear-eyed about what needs to happen. Aoi's name at the end softens it — making sure she knows he's thinking about her team's comfort too.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。新作の、ひき肉の創作料理、メニューに、入れたいですね。
lines.en: Yes. That new ground meat dish you've been working on — I really think it should be on the new menu.
lines.style: Warm closing note. Genuine appreciation in the tone. Slightly trailing off, like she's offering something tender. The yes that means agreement and affection both.
